comments.body:
Merged the latest `develop` into this branch to resolve the conflict (only `ChoreReq` needed a manual merge: the new `SectionID` field plus this PR's next-due-date handling).

Heads-up: `go build ./...` currently fails on `develop` itself, independent of this PR: `internal/notifier/push/push.go:99` has `return nil` in a function that returns `(int, error)`. So CI here will be red until that is fixed upstream; with that one line patched locally, the build and `go test ./internal/chore` pass.
Gentle ping: is there anything I can do to help get this reviewed? Happy to adjust or split it if that makes it easier.
